required_fixes: Fix Dirichlet-Multinomial K to match frozen spec: spec.json measurement_validity items 5-6 and prereg.md 4.3 require K=n_states=12 categories for both M1 and M0. Code run_experiment.py:_dirichlet_multinomial_log_marginal uses K=len(counts) (observed distinct next_states, 1-4) instead of fixed K=12. Must use K=12 in lgamma(K*alpha)-lgamma(N+K*alpha) with zero-count categories contributing 0 to sum_i term. Re-run full 500 within-session shuffles after fix.

Increase N_SHUFFLE to >=1000 (ideally 1999 or 4999) so permutation p=(count_ge+1)/(N+1) can achieve p<0.001 threshold. With N=500, minimum p=0.001996 >0.001 makes C3 p<0.001 unreachable in principle; current C3 evaluation via 99.9th percentile via np.percentile is interpolation and inconsistent with p definition. Align decision_rule, analysis code, and prereg p threshold.

Recompute and rewrite result.json/report.md after fixes; do not claim FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING from buggy null. Corrected analysis must be a new frozen experiment or a formally amended re-execution with updated provenance and artifact hashes.

Document prior sensitivity correctly: with corrected K=12, report both absolute log BF scale (nats) and relative evidence (BF vs null distribution) and clarify that Bayes factor scale (nats) is not directly comparable to CMI bits scale, but null median sign is the validity criterion.

validity_findings.finding: Implementation violates frozen spec formula. spec.json measurement_validity: M1 K1=n_states=12 per (s,a), M0 K0=12 per s; prereg.md 4.3 identical; spec measurement_validity item 8 gives exact log ML formula with K*alpha. Code run_experiment.py:234-235 sets K=len(counts) (number of observed next-state categories, typically 1-4 due to 4 candidates per (s,a)), not K=12. This under-penalizes M1 (many small strata with K~2) relative to M0 (larger strata with K~4-6 observed), producing systematic positive bias under null. Recomputation proves this single bug explains entire FALSIFIED verdict.

validity_findings.impact: Producer C1 (null median <0) fails for all alphas (+3621 to +4047 nats) under buggy code; with corrected K=12, all alphas PASS C1 (null_median -78 to -131 nats) and C3 (observed 167-643 nats >> null 99.9th -37 to -99 nats, p=0.001996 via 500 perms capped, actually observed exceeds max null by 200-500 nats). Verdict flips from FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING to SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST. Producer outcome FALSIFIES is not justified as executed.

validity_findings.finding: With N_SHUFFLE=500, permutation p=(count_ge+1)/(N+1) has minimum 0.001996 > 0.001 threshold required by C3 (prereg.md 6: p<0.001). Even perfect separation (observed > all 500 nulls) yields p=0.001996 which fails C3 under strict p threshold, making SURVIVES impossible in principle. Code evaluates C3 via observed > 99.9th percentile (np.percentile interpolation) rather than p threshold, creating inconsistency between reported p_value and C3 decision. 99.9th percentile with 500 samples is estimated by extrapolation beyond data (99.9% of 500 = 499.5th order statistic).

claim_ceiling: MEASUREMENT_INVALID: No justified claim about Bayesian model comparison on this SPA class can be derived from the as-executed packet. The producer's FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING verdict (C1: all null medians >=0, Occam fails) is an artifact of implementation bug (K=len(observed) vs K=12) and does not support the interpretation that Laplace-smoothed-independent Bayesian comparison fails. Corrected recomputation on the same data shows the opposite: with spec-compliant K=12, all three alpha_prior values have null median strongly negative (-78 to -131 nats) and observed log BF strongly exceeds null (by 200-500 nats, exceeding max of 500 shuffles), satisfying both C1 and C3. The maximum justified ceiling from this evidence is therefore NULL: the experiment as run is invalid and cannot be used to update C-MEAS-VALID or C-WEB-DYNAMICS. Exploratory corrected analysis is hypothesis-generating only and suggests the Bayesian paradigm SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST on this SPA at N=5000, but requires a new frozen re-execution with fixed K, N>=1000 permutations, and updated provenance before any confirmatory claim.
